caption:
One marker per seed. Each system against its own bar on the 106 held-out theorems that need classical proof by contradiction (σ,
Dan's strict set), set by the same rule (the median of its own full bases before RL) on different measures: ours 26.3 as E32 (the
expected number a 32-sample draw solves) from snapshot reads of our three S1g3 bases; Dan's 14 as his cumulative count (theorems a
32-sample draw has solved in any round so far) of his 6 K12 full bases at round 1, which favours his points and so understates the
gap. y: (6 × trained + 2 × sampled tokens) ÷ (6 × Stage-1 tokens), prompt prefill excluded. Filled: first crossing, interpolated in
log y between checkpoints; ▼: at the first checkpoint (an upper bound); hollow: at the bar before RL; ▲ on a thin line: not reached
by that y; cross on a dotted line: the recipe's think-ban guard ended the line there (censored; counted as not reached by that y,
the conservative reading, since excluding it would flatter the arm); hollow on a dashed line: the guard-relaxed continuation
(Amendment 4, secondary): circle reached, triangle not by the cap, x stopped again by the relaxed guard, diamond stopped for machine
availability; open hexagon: a ko_strict line reaching the Dan-matched cumulative count (our first-32 solves unioned every 35
iterations, against our bar of 27 on that measure). Colour: GRPO with programmatic thinking traces on our pool (39.5–44.5 % of
targets σ-covered); black edge: the same GRPO on Dan's 4,495 EI targets (2.7 %); grey: Dan's T1 expert-iteration ladders, with his
bar and measure, on this y (his own x adds re-read state prefill and replay: 1.5–1.9 × these values after round 1; round 1, sampling
only, is drawn on the floor). Differences from Dan: GRPO, not EI; a thinking model (programmatic search traces); no pretraining
replay; S1g3 bases (σ 2.48 %, not 10.9 %); doses of 0.1 % and 1.0 % of the proofs; ko has no σ proofs, but 0.41 % of its records
plan the σ detour in their narration at the effort level the bases trained on; ko_strict removes the 949 records with such a plan at
any level.
